title: MBD3 promotes epithelial-mesenchymal transition in gastric cancer cells
author: Wang, Min, et al.
materials: The plasmids sh-EGFP, sh-MBD3, 3 × Flag-vector (shown as Vector) and Flag-MBD3 were obtained from the Institute of Medical Science, Jiangsu University (Zhenjiang, Jiangsu, China). The sequence was confirmed through DNA sequencing. Lipofectamine 2000 reagent (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA) was used for cell transfection based on the manufacturer’s protocols. Each well of a 6-well plate contained 2 μg plasmids and 10 μL Lipofectamine 2000.

steps.title: Culture gastric cell lines
steps.instruction: Thaw and maintain GES‑1, SGC‑7901, MGC‑803, and HGC‑27 cells in DMEM (Meilunbio) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin (HyClone) at 37 °C in a humidified 5 % CO₂ incubator; authenticate each line by short tandem repeat (STR) analysis before use.

steps.title: Assess MBD3 expression
steps.instruction: Measure MBD3 protein levels by western blotting and mRNA levels by quantitative real‑time PCR (qRT‑PCR) using the appropriate antibodies and primers.

steps.title: Evaluate EMT and PI3K/AKT markers
steps.instruction: Perform western blotting to detect epithelial‑mesenchymal transition (EMT) markers and phosphatidylinositide 3‑kinase/AKT (PI3K/AKT) pathway proteins.

steps.title: Conduct migration and invasion assays
steps.instruction: Assess gastric cancer cell migration, invasion, and proliferation using transwell chambers, wound‑healing assays, Cell Counting Kit‑8 (CCK‑8), colony‑formation assays, and xenograft mouse models.

steps.title: Transfect cells with plasmids
steps.instruction: In each well of a 6‑well plate, add 2 µg of plasmid DNA (sh‑EGFP, sh‑MBD3, 3×Flag‑vector, or Flag‑MBD3) and 10 µL Lipofectamine 2000 (Invitrogen) following the manufacturer’s protocol; incubate to allow transfection.

steps.title: Perform RNA sequencing
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from transfected cells and submit for high‑throughput RNA sequencing to identify downstream targets of MBD3.

steps.title: Prognostic bioinformatic analysis
steps.instruction: Using the TCGA dataset, generate Kaplan–Meier survival plots, time‑dependent ROC curves (timeROC), risk‑score maps, calibration plots, and nomograms with the R packages survival, rms, ggplot2, and survminer; test significance with log‑rank test (P < 0.05).

steps.title: Statistical analysis of data
steps.instruction: Perform each experiment at least three independent times; present results as mean ± SD; analyze two‑group comparisons with Student’s t‑test and >2‑group comparisons with two‑way ANOVA using GraphPad Prism 8; consider P < 0.05 statistically significant.
